name: Set up OCaml
description: Set up an OCaml and opam environment and add to PATH

allow-prerelease-opam.description: Allow to use a pre-release version of opam.

ocaml-compiler.description: The OCaml compiler packages to initialise.

opam-repositories.description: The name and URL pair of the repository to fetch the packages from.

opam-pin.description: Enable the automation feature for opam pin.

opam-depext.description: Enable the automation feature for opam depext.

opam-depext-flags.description: The flags for the opam depext command.

opam-local-packages.description: The local packages to be used by `opam-pin` or `opam-depext`.

cache-prefix.description: The prefix of the cache keys.
